svg.aria-label: Karnak DICOM gateway: DICOM data from every modality is transformed into de-identified, tag-morphed and conformant data.
svg.title: Karnak — DICOM gateway
svg.desc: Volume imaging, radiography, ultrasound, video, pathology, signal and report objects flow into the Karnak DICOM gateway and come out de-identified, tag-morphed and conformant.

a.text: Deterministic UIDs from a project secret
Pseudonyms from CSV, DICOM tags or an API
Date shifting or reduced date precision

svg.text: A standard node in your network

a.text: C-STORE in, C-STORE or STOW-RS out

svg.text: No identifiers in tags or pixels

a.text: If masking fails, nothing is sent
Email summaries of transfers and errors
Diagnostic value of the image preserved
